name: Necropolis
description: The Necropolis was a junk planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was connected to the worlds of Rattatak and Ponemah Terminal by a hyperspace route. During their journey to find Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, Rey, Chewbacca, and R2-D2 were forced to land on Necropolis after a mechanical issue.
